what: When the pointer is over a post list row, the row background changes to a pale flat fill with no curve, a thumbnail window (117×66) opens at once on the left of the row and the image inside slides in from outside the left over .75s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), and the title slides 140px right on the same curve to make room. On release all three return with no curve — a work list hover that moves only on entering.

options.[data-fx-part=thumb]: Thumbnail window (child) — holds one picture (img or span). The window’s left edge is --fx-left
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text that gets pushed away (children, all together if several). Sponsor and director cells that must not be pushed as a whole line are left out, only the title gets it
options.--fx-push: Distance the title is pushed, default 140px

use: Work TitleAdvertiser
note: On touch devices (no hover), the implementer adds .is-fx-on to the one row crossing the screen center and it looks the same (original: ScrollTrigger top center → bottom center). The title cell is overflow:hidden so the pushed-out end is clipped
